summary.text: Anita Gonzales is a Democratic state representative from New Mexico who has represented House District 70 since January 1, 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She works as a program coordinator.

paragraphs.text: Gonzales was born in Las Vegas, New Mexico, attended Texas A&M University and New Mexico Highlands University, earned a degree in 2004, and earned a graduate degree from New Mexico Highlands University in 2007.
Her career experience includes working as a statewide program coordinator with NM MESA, Inc., and as a regional manager with the New Mexico Hispanic Youth Institute.
